evals.name: text-interview-new-park
evals.prompt: 帮我给『滨江科创园』做一个智慧运行驾驶舱的3D数字孪生大屏。园区有三栋楼：研发楼12层、办公楼6层、会展中心3层，还有一个地下车库大概400个车位差不多九成满。配色就用现在的赛博蓝。先别急着写一堆代码——我想先看到你整理出来的园区规格（每栋楼的尺寸、位置、类别、车库占用、图例、楼幢切换标签），确认没问题再生成场景。
evals.expected_output: A validated Park Spec JSON for 滨江科创园 with 3 buildings (研发楼 building 12F, 办公楼 building 6F, 会展中心 building 3F) + one garage-category building (v1.3: no capacity/occupied in spec) + legend (楼幢/地下车库) + switcher tabs (全局视角/研发楼/办公楼/会展中心/地下车库), written to the output dir. Garage occupancy (capacity 400, ~360 occupied, ~40 empty) is captured as a parking POI in the dynamic mock data (v1.5). Followed by: static scaffold src/data/<park>.ts (footprint geometry only) + the 5-file IDigitalTwinApi contract layer (mock derived from spec) + ParkScene.ts wiring gridGround.glsl floor + category-colored buildings + garage entrance, with onMounted hydration.
expectations: Produces a spec.json that passes scripts/validate_spec.py (exit 0)
Spec has exactly 3 non-garage buildings + 1 garage-category building
All three non-garage buildings are category:building
Spec has NO garage.capacity/occupied fields (v1.3 removed); the 400/~360/~40 occupancy lives in mockPois as a parking-category POI's occupancy (v1.5)
Generated ParkScene.ts imports gridGround.glsl?raw and wires a ShaderMaterial floor
Buildings are colored by category (cyan/mint) from tokens, not hardcoded
Switcher list includes 全局视角 and 地下车库
Generated ParkScene.ts derives the ortho frustum from spec geometry with content fill K≈0.66 (park occupies ~2/3 of the frame, surrounding roads/greenery visible), instead of the v1.1 K=0.88 close-up
Generated scene builds the §10 park environment (internal loop road + surface parking + street trees + surrounding municipal roads + gate + street lamps), driven by spec.environment or smart defaults

Generated 5-file IDigitalTwinApi contract layer: api/types/digital-twin.ts + api/interfaces/(manager/)digital-twin.ts + api/modules/manager/digital-twin.ts + mock/api/manager/digital-twin.ts + mock/data/manager/digital-twin.ts (v1.5)
IDigitalTwinApi has getBuildings/getFloorDetail/getPois; createDigitalTwinApi() switches Real/Mock by VITE_MOCK_ENABLED (v1.5)
mockBuildings/mockPois are derived from spec (研发楼/办公楼/会展中心 names+floors; parking POI with occupancy 400/~360/~40) (v1.5)
GlobalTwin.vue onMounted calls getBuildings()+getPois() and hydrates the scene; static scaffold (footprint+environment) renders before hydration; floor click calls getFloorDetail() (v1.5)

Static scaffold src/data/<park>.ts contains ONLY basic info (footprint geometry id/w/d/x/z/category/facing + style + legend + environment, v2.1 generated by scripts/generate_data.py) — NOT building names/floors/POIs (v1.5)
Generated useSelection.ts exposes effBuildingId/effFloorIndex computed (hover ?? focused) AND a selectFloor(b, f) that writes focusedBuildingId + floorIndex atomically in one call (v1.5.1)

Generated ParkScene floor-click handler (pointerup) calls ONLY onSelect(bid, fin) on the click path — does NOT also invoke onFocus/focusBuilding (which would clear floorIndex and make the gold border vanish after mouseleave) (v1.5.1)
Generated GlobalTwin.vue drives the gold overlay via watch([effBuildingId, effFloorIndex]) -> scene.setSelection, so a selected floor keeps its gold border after the mouse leaves the canvas (v1.5.1)

evals.name: pen-design-source
evals.prompt: 用项目根目录的 数字孪生.pen 这个设计稿，把全局视角的3D数字孪生场景按稿子还原出来。现在代码里那个地面是深色沥青贴图、不是设计稿里的发光网格，图例也没了——要按赛博风格修好。先把规格从设计稿里抽出来给我看。
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/extract_pen.py on 数字孪生.pen to draft a spec (tokens, grid uniforms u_cell=46/u_gridColor=#2a7fff/u_strength=0.85, buildings 综合楼5F/主楼10F/服务楼3F; v1.3 extractor no longer reads garage occupancy), fills id/category/w/d/x/z from the Scene, generates the cyber-spec-correct scene wiring the grid shader. Garage/lot occupancy (if the .pen sign shows 320/96) is captured via interview/default as a parking POI occupancy in mockPois (v1.5). All outputs saved to the output dir, including the 5-file IDigitalTwinApi contract layer.
expectations: Produces a spec.json derived from 数字孪生.pen (title contains 智慧运行驾驶舱, 3 buildings from the headers)
Spec shaders.grid matches the .pen fill uniforms (u_gridColor #2a7fff, u_cell 46, u_strength 0.85)
Spec has NO garage.capacity/empty fields (v1.3); any 320/96 occupancy is a parking POI occupancy in mockPois, not in spec (v1.5)
All non-garage buildings are category:building
Generated ParkScene.ts wires the gridGround.glsl ShaderMaterial floor
Generated scene includes a garage entrance (half-pyramid + P sign) with NO occupancy sign/progress bar in 3D (v1.3); occupancy shown via parking POI tooltip from getPois() (v1.5)
Generated scene default framing shows the full park panorama (K≈0.66) and includes the §10 environment (roads/greenery/surrounding) from the .pen decorative layers
Generated IDigitalTwinApi contract layer (5 files) with mock data derived from the spec; RealDigitalTwinApi calls /api/manager/park/* (v1.5)

evals.name: fix-extend-existing
evals.prompt: 现在的数字孪生大屏有几个问题想修：1）地面是深色沥青贴图、不是发光网格；2）没有图例，楼的颜色没按类别（楼幢/地下车库）区分；3）楼幢切换里没有『地下车库』这一项。帮我按赛博风格把这些修好。给出改动的关键文件就行。
evals.expected_output: Identifies the exemplar gaps (shader not wired, no legend, no category coloring, missing 地下车库 tab) and produces the corrected key files (ParkScene.ts with shader floor + category colors + legend overlay, the garage entrance, and the 5-entry switcher list), saved to the output dir, without rewriting the whole app.
expectations: Output diagnoses the 3 stated problems (shader, legend/category, 地下车库 tab)
Corrected ParkScene.ts imports and wires gridGround.glsl (ShaderMaterial floor)
Corrected scene colors buildings by category and includes a Legend overlay with 楼幢/地下车库
Corrected switcher list has 5 entries including 地下车库
Does not reintroduce hardcoded park content — references a spec/tokens

evals.name: environment-richer-default
evals.prompt: 给『云栖智造园』做个数字孪生大屏，赛博风格就行。园区有 4 栋楼和一个地下车库，具体你看着安排。我想看到的是一张能看全整个园区和周边环境的全景大图，不要那种把楼怼到镜头前的特写。
evals.expected_output: A validated Park Spec for 云栖智造园 (4 buildings + 1 garage, cyber style). Because the user gave no environment details, spec.environment is either omitted (smart defaults) or populated with sensible defaults — in either case the generated scene is NOT a bare 'buildings + empty ground' anymore. The scene includes internal roads, surface parking, street trees / green patches, surrounding municipal roads, a main gate, and street lamps; cyber ground-glow markings on. Default framing is a panorama: park content fills ~2/3 of the frame (K≈0.66) with surrounding roads/greenery visible around it, and the wheel can zoom out further (~0.45). Dynamic data (building names/floors, POIs) goes through the IDigitalTwinApi contract layer with mock data derived from spec.
expectations: Produces a spec.json that passes scripts/validate_spec.py (exit 0); environment is either omitted or a valid object
Generated ParkScene.ts frames the park at K≈0.66 (park ~2/3 of frame, surrounding environment visible) — NOT the v1.1 K=0.88 close-up
OrbitControls zoom clamp min is ~0.45 so the user can zoom out to see the whole panorama
Generated scene builds internal roads (loop/cross/grid) inside the boundary
Generated scene includes surface parking stalls (with vehicle proxies matching occupancy) — count derived from building scale when not specified
Generated scene includes greenery: grass patches + street trees (trunk + canopy), density 'normal' by default
Generated scene includes surrounding municipal roads on all 4 sides + main entrance gate
Generated scene includes street lamps; cyber ground-glow markings (Line2 emissive road lines) are visible
Environment meshes do NOT enter pickables[] — building floor raycast selection still works correctly
All environment colors come from the cyber theme tokens environment block, not hardcoded hex

Generated IDigitalTwinApi contract layer (5 files); GlobalTwin.vue hydrates buildings+POIs on mount via getBuildings()+getPois(); camera framing uses static geometry only (does not wait for hydration) (v1.5)

evals.name: dynamic-data-via-api
evals.prompt: 我们这个园区数字孪生大屏，现在楼名、楼层、设备/监控/停车场点位都是写死在前端页面里的，运维那边希望这些数据从后端 API 实时拿。基本不变的东西（楼的位置、园区道路绿化、配色）还放页面里就行。开发阶段先用 mock 数据跑通，正式上线接真实后端。帮我按这个思路改。
evals.expected_output: Refactors the digital twin so data is layered: basic info (building footprint geometry, environment, theme tokens, stage) stays statically inlined; dynamic data (building names/floor counts/floor_ids, floor detail on click, POI points incl. devices/cameras/parking with realtime status + occupancy) flows through an IDigitalTwinApi contract layer following api-typescript-spec (5 files + Real/Mock factory, VITE_MOCK_ENABLED switch). Page uses a scaffold-first-then-hydrate load sequence. Includes a backend contract doc listing the 3 endpoints the backend must implement. Outputs the contract-layer files + the hydration wiring in GlobalTwin.vue, saved to the output dir.
expectations: Output clearly separates basic (static) vs dynamic (API) data in a table or explicit list, matching the v1.5 partition (geometry/environment/tokens = static; names/floors/floor-detail/POIs = dynamic)
Generated src/api/types/digital-twin.ts defines BuildingRuntimeItem, FloorDetail (+UnitDetail), PoiRuntimeItem, PoiStatusEnum, PoiTypeEnum and the *Params types — all snake_case

Generated src/api/interfaces/(manager/)digital-twin.ts defines IDigitalTwinApi with getBuildings(): Promise<BuildingRuntimeItem[]>, getFloorDetail(params): Promise<FloorDetail>, getPois(params?): Promise<PoiRuntimeItem[]> (GET-only, no response envelope)

Generated src/api/modules/manager/digital-twin.ts has RealDigitalTwinApi (calling /api/manager/park/buildings, /floor-detail, /pois) + createDigitalTwinApi() factory switching by MOCK_ENABLED + module singleton digitalTwinApi

Generated src/mock/api/manager/digital-twin.ts (MockDigitalTwinApi) + src/mock/data/manager/digital-twin.ts (mock data derived from the spec: building names/floors, POIs with status + parking occupancy)
createDigitalTwinApi() branches on VITE_MOCK_ENABLED (string 'true'/'false', NOT VITE_USE_MOCK); .env sets true for dev, .env.production sets false for prod (or reuses admin template .env)

GlobalTwin.vue onMounted does Promise.all([getBuildings(), getPois()]) then scene.hydrateBuildings()/hydratePois(); floor click calls getFloorDetail(); loading/empty/error states are handled (scaffold stays interactive on failure)
Static scaffold (src/data/<park>.ts) contains ONLY basic info (footprint geometry + style + legend + environment) — building names/floors and POIs are NOT statically inlined
Camera framing (frameCamera) uses only static geometry and does NOT wait for dynamic data (no white screen pre-hydration)

Output includes a backend contract doc (or section) listing the 3 GET endpoints with route, QueryMap, returned *Map DTO (snake_case), permission string, and Controller name — front-first, aligned with net-api-developer

Adapts to host: if src/api/request.ts + src/config exist (admin template) they are reused and the interface file is flat (interfaces/digital-twin.ts); otherwise a minimal fetch-based request.ts + config + .env are generated

evals.name: negative-malformed-spec
evals.prompt: 我整理了个园区规格，你先帮我校验一下有没有问题再生成。规格在 spec.json：有一栋普通楼没写楼层数、style 写成了 'neon'、有个 POI 的 buildingId 指向不存在的楼、有两栋楼的占地完全重叠。
evals.expected_output: Runs validate_spec.py and reports every FAIL/WARN WITHOUT generating the scene. The validator must catch: missing floors on a building-category entry, unknown style 'neon', POI buildingId not matching any building, and overlapping building footprints (v2.1 layout check). The assistant fixes each FAIL before proceeding.
expectations: Output runs scripts/validate_spec.py and reports exit code 1 with specific FAIL lines
Validator flags the building-category entry missing 'floors' (v1.8 B1 — was previously silent)
Validator flags style 'neon' as not in the 3-style enum
Validator flags the POI buildingId that doesn't match any buildings[].id
Assistant does NOT proceed to generate the scene until every FAIL is resolved

evals.name: dynamic-data-failure-modes
evals.prompt: 数字孪生页面要能扛住后端异常：楼栋接口正常但 POI 接口挂了、快速连点不同楼层、某个楼层详情 404。帮我加上这些降级。
evals.expected_output: Hardened hydration (v1.8): Promise.allSettled so POI failure doesn't kill buildings; AbortSignal + onCleanup on the floor-detail watch so rapid clicks don't race; floor-detail 404 shows inline error + retry in UnitDetail (not silently swallowed); unified ApiError so 401/404/5xx/timeout are distinguishable.
expectations: GlobalTwin.vue onMounted uses Promise.allSettled (not Promise.all) with per-method error state (v1.8)
A POI request failing leaves buildings hydrated and interactive (not wiped) (v1.8)
The floor-detail watch uses onCleanup + AbortController to cancel the previous in-flight request on rapid floor switching (v1.8)
A 404 on getFloorDetail surfaces an inline error + retry in the UnitDetail panel, not a silent catch {} (v1.8)
request<T>() supports a signal (AbortSignal) and timeout; network/timeout errors are wrapped in ApiError(0, ...) (v1.8)
Mock and Real both throw ApiError (Mock 404 for missing floor), so error handling is mode-invariant (v1.8)

evals.name: responsive-accessibility
evals.prompt: 这个数字孪生大屏要在不同屏幕和键盘用户下都能用——有的人用笔记本不是 4K 大屏，有的人只用键盘不用鼠标。帮我加上响应式和可访问性。
evals.expected_output: Adds the v1.8 responsive + a11y layer: DPR ≤ 2; resize debounce; switcher role=tab + arrow-key nav; canvas aria-label; POI/UnitDetail focus management + Esc; prefers-reduced-motion disables tween & breathing; empty state when getBuildings() returns [].
expectations: renderer.setPixelRatio uses Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2) (v1.8)
Resize callbacks are debounced (~150ms), not run every frame (v1.8)
BuildingSwitcher uses role='tab'/'tablist' + arrow-key navigation (v1.8)
The canvas has role='img' + a descriptive aria-label (v1.8)
POI popup and UnitDetail move focus in on open and restore it on Esc close (v1.8)
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables the focus tween and POI alarm breathing animation (v1.8)
getBuildings() returning [] shows an empty-state overlay with a retry button (v1.8)

evals.name: webgl-context-loss-dispose
evals.prompt: 我们的数字孪生页面在切后台标签页回来或者显卡驱动休眠后偶尔变黑，切楼栋标签页时也偶尔卡。帮我修好生命周期。
evals.expected_output: Adds v1.8 WebGL context loss handling and a full dispose checklist: webglcontextlost/restored listeners; stop RAF on loss + restore overlay; full dispose on unmount (RAF, ResizeObserver, OrbitControls, geometry/material/texture, composer, renderer.forceContextLoss); long-lived singleton surviving tab switches.
expectations: canvas listens to webglcontextlost (preventDefault + stop RAF + show restore overlay) and webglcontextrestored (rebuild GPU resources + restart RAF) (v1.8)

GlobalTwin.vue onBeforeUnmount calls a full scene.dispose() covering RAF, ResizeObserver.disconnect, OrbitControls.dispose, geometry/material/texture disposal, composer + renderer.dispose + forceContextLoss (v1.8)
ParkScene is a long-lived singleton that survives BuildingSwitcher tab switches (not rebuilt per tab) (v1.8)
The scene does NOT continue rendering after a context-lost event (would throw) (v1.8)

evals.name: backend-contract-envelope-rejection
evals.prompt: 后端同学说他返回的数据包了一层 { code, message, data }，前端直接读 data 就行。数字孪生前端契约这边怎么处理？
evals.expected_output: Explains the envelope-absence rule and confirms the contract: the digital twin GET endpoints return the entity/array directly (no {code,message,data}); if a backend stub wraps in an envelope, the frontend types (snake_case direct fields) would mismatch and the Real implementation must NOT silently unwrap — it should push the backend to drop the envelope per net-api-developer / api-typescript-spec.
expectations: Output states the digital twin endpoints return entities/arrays directly with NO {code,message,data} envelope (aligned with api-typescript-spec)
Output does NOT suggest silently unwrapping resp.data in the frontend (that would hide a backend contract violation)
Backend DTO field names are snake_case and match the frontend types (BuildingRuntimeItem/FloorDetail/PoiRuntimeItem) (v1.8 contract)
Lists the 3 GET endpoints with route, QueryMap, *Map DTO, permission, Controller (front-first)

evals.name: v2-1-cured-determinism-and-realism
evals.prompt: 给『未来港科技园』做个数字孪生大屏。3 栋楼（研发楼 9F、综合楼 5F、展示中心 3F）+ 地下车库，风格用写实夜景(night-realistic)。我希望有夜景氛围：星空+月亮+发光窗、楼顶有机房天线、路上有标线。另外园区里要个小水景。尺寸位置你安排，但别把楼摆穿模了。
evals.expected_output: A validated Park Spec (style='night-realistic', greenery.waterFeature=true) — building positions either from scripts/layout_park.py or hand-placed then confirmed via validate_spec.py v2.1 layout checks (no overlap/out-of-bounds). Data layer generated by scripts (generate_data.py for scaffold+mock, generate_theme.py for tokens.css). 2D components copied from assets/components/ (13 files). Scene shows v2.1 details: programmatic starfield + moon in the night sky, rooftop machine-room + antenna per building, road center dashes + gate zebra crossing, water feature with reflective surface. Labels readable (ui.labelBg/labelText pair).
expectations: Produces a spec.json that passes scripts/validate_spec.py (exit 0) including the v2.1 layout checks (no AABB overlap/gap<20, nothing out of boundary, POIs inside boundary+20)

src/data/<park>.ts and src/mock/data/manager/digital-twin.ts are generated by scripts/generate_data.py (NOT hand-written); mock data contains the spec building names (研发楼/综合楼/展示中心) and re-running the script produces byte-identical output (deterministic seed)
src/styles/tokens.css is generated by scripts/generate_theme.py and contains --twin-ui-* variables (panelOpacity/glowStrength/labelBg/labelText/switcherStyle) matching the chosen theme JSON

All 13 assets/components/ files are copied into the project (GlobalTwin/CenterStage/BuildingSwitcher/UnitDetail/GarageCard/LegendPanel/PoiOverlay/TourToggleButton + useSelection/useScaleBoard/useTwinData/useTour + theme.ts); component CSS uses var(--twin-*) with zero hex literals
spec.environment.greenery.waterFeature is true; generated scene renders the water surface + rim (CircleGeometry + RingGeometry at token environment.water color)

Generated ParkScene.ts (from assets/park-scene.impl.ts) includes buildRooftopKit wiring (machine-room box + antenna per building, seeded by buildingId) and buildRoadMarkings (center dashes InstancedMesh + zebra + driveway + arrow at token environment.roadMarking color)
night-realistic style shows programmatic starfield + moon in the background texture (scene.sky.stars=true, moon=true); cyber shows sparse stars; realistic has sky all-off
Roof name labels sit ABOVE the roof (y = h + 22, not h/2 + 22) and use token ui.labelBg/labelText pair (readable in light styles — no black-on-black labels)
frameCamera is re-run after hydrateBuildings with real max floors (not the default 18-floor estimate), so the park fills ~2/3 of the frame
ParkSceneCallbacks includes onPoiHover; PoiOverlay shows a hover name tooltip (HTML, not a Sprite) and projects only the currently-open POI card
Building trees alternate sphere/cone canopies and grass patches have bush clusters (InstancedMesh)
npm run typecheck passes cleanly with the generated data files + copied components + ParkScene (strict TS, resolveJsonModule on)

evals.name: aerial-tour-orbit
evals.prompt: 给『星河智谷』做个数字孪生大屏，赛博风格。3 栋楼（研发楼 10F、总部 16F、会展 4F）+ 地下车库。我希望大屏有个航拍巡航功能——点一下相机就自动绕着园区缓慢飞一圈展示，像无人机拍的。尺寸位置你安排，先给我规格确认。
evals.expected_output: A validated Park Spec for 星河智谷 (3 buildings + 1 garage, cyber style). The generated ParkScene.ts (from assets/park-scene.impl.ts) implements v2.2 航拍巡航: a setTourEnabled(on) imperative API that frames the camera to a bird's-eye view (K≈0.55 framingK, higher elevation ~1.0 rad) via a frameTween (easeOutCubic, ~0.6s) then enables OrbitControls.autoRotate at speed≈0.6; turning off (button or user drag) disables autoRotate and tweens back to the default K=0.66 framing. frameCamera is refactored to a positionAndFrame(K, elevation, az) core. A TourToggleButton.vue (role='switch' + aria-checked, styled via var(--twin-ui-*), zero hex) sits top-right and reads/writes a useTour.ts module singleton; GlobalTwin.vue wires watch(tour.enabled → scene.setTourEnabled) + onTourAutoExit callback → useTour.disable(). spec.cameraTour is optional (omitted → smart defaults still work) or present (enabled/speed/elevation/framingK/pauseOnInteract); generate_data.py writes it into ParkScaffold.cameraTour (static). prefers-reduced-motion disables the feature (setTourEnabled no-op, button aria-disabled). validate_spec.py rejects bad cameraTour (speed≤0, framingK∉(0,1), elevation∉[0,π/2]).
expectations: Produces a spec.json that passes scripts/validate_spec.py (exit 0); spec.cameraTour is either omitted (smart defaults) or a valid object

Generated ParkScene.ts exposes setTourEnabled(on: boolean) and implements the orbit tour as a FINITE-DURATION frameTween (K/elevation, easeOutCubic) + OrbitControls.autoRotate steady-state — NOT a per-frame unconditional lerp (same release-controls discipline as §8 focus tween)
Generated frameCamera is refactored into a positionAndFrame(K, elevation, az) core; setTourEnabled tweens K≈0.66→0.55 (framingK) and elevation→~1.0 (bird's-eye) on enter, back to defaults on exit
OrbitControls.autoRotate is enabled only AFTER the enter tween completes and disabled immediately on user pointer-down (pauseOnInteract default true); wheel/zoom does NOT exit the tour
Generated TourToggleButton.vue uses role='switch' + aria-checked + aria-label, is positioned top-right, and its CSS uses only var(--twin-ui-*) (zero hex literals)

Generated useTour.ts is a module-level singleton (enabled ref + enable/disable/toggle) mirroring the useSelection pattern; GlobalTwin.vue wires watch(tour.enabled → scene.setTourEnabled) and passes onTourAutoExit: () => tour.disable() to ParkScene
When prefers-reduced-motion is set, setTourEnabled(true) is a no-op and TourToggleButton renders aria-disabled + disabled (autoRotate is motion, same discipline as the §8 tween/breathing disable)
generate_data.py emits spec.cameraTour into ParkScaffold.cameraTour in src/data/<park>.ts when provided (and omits it cleanly when not); re-running is byte-identical (deterministic)
validate_spec.py returns exit 1 with specific FAIL lines for a bad cameraTour (speed=0, framingK=1.5, elevation=2, unknown key) and exit 0 for a valid/omitted one

The tour works across all 3 styles without breaking the existing framing / engine realism enhancements (env map, bloom, AO — enabled in realistic/night-realistic, retained-but-off in cyber) — tour only changes framing + autoRotate, not materials/lights

evals.name: building-type-differentiation
evals.prompt: 我们的园区数字孪生里写字楼和居民楼长得一模一样，业主方吐槽分不清。帮我让不同类型楼栋外观区分开：园区里有写字楼A座（22层点式塔楼）、居民楼B栋（15层板式）、商业中心（12层带底商）。希望一眼能看出哪个是办公楼、哪个是住宅、哪个是商业。
